topic: A wedding photographer answers the five questions couples ask before booking, as a chat. Lumen & Lace is a made-up example.

slides.title: Before you book a wedding photographer
slides.subtitle: The five questions couples ask us every week, answered straight.

slides.title: How far ahead should we book you?
slides.body: Summer Saturdays book up *12 to 18 months* ahead. Fridays, Sundays and winter dates often work with 4 to 6 months’ notice.

slides.kicker: How many photos do we get?
slides.label: edited photos from a 10-hour wedding day
slides.note: Our average last season. No near-duplicates, no filler: every one is worth printing.

slides.title: When do we get our photos?
slides.body: A sneak peek of 40 favorites within 72 hours, while the day still feels fresh. The full gallery follows in *6 to 8 weeks*.

slides.title: What if your camera breaks mid-ceremony?

items.title: Two cameras
items.text: Both on us all day, so a swap takes seconds.

items.title: Two cards
items.text: Every shot is saved to two memory cards at once.

items.title: Two backups
items.text: Files are copied to two drives the same night.

slides.title: Do we need a second photographer?
slides.caption: Past 100 guests, yes: one of us stays with you, the other catches every reaction.

slides.quote: Before you book anyone, ask to see one full wedding gallery. Highlights show the best twenty frames. The full gallery shows your whole day.
slides.author: Lumen & Lace

slides.title: Got a date in mind?
slides.text: Send it with your venue. We check the calendar the same day and answer honestly.

caption:
Five questions every couple asks before booking a wedding photographer, answered straight.

We get them every week, so here they are in one place.
